dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: "'I wish to become a witch's familiar,' said the young lady."

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Hehe... Yes, I know. If we were in this story, I would choose you all to be my familiars, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Now then, shall I continue reading?
